dispositions.cleared: Provenance traced to public sources or to black-box observations with acquisition metadata, with nothing in the record tying the content to non-public source, disassembly or a tainted generator. A cleared input may enter the release source allowlist when its read disposition is port.
dispositions.tainted: The record ties the content to non-public source (the CRT files of the NT source tree), to a reverse-engineering pass whose records are not in any pinned repository, or to tainted code that it copies, exists to expose, or was generated by; nothing records an independent derivation. Never a port source and never read for behaviour; replacements are written fresh from public ISA behaviour and black-box witnesses.
dispositions.unresolved: Provenance or license is not established either way by what this review read. Not a port source, not read for behaviour, and out of the release source allowlist until a later review clears it.

precedence: A module entry names one path at one blob and applies before any class; when the pinned blob differs from the reviewed one, the input is at least unresolved until the new blob is reviewed (a tainted entry stays tainted). Otherwise the first class whose selector matches applies. An input that the pin quarantines (the excel_numeric directory, or quarantine_derived) and that no entry matches is unresolved. Then the rules, by the orchestrator's content-derivation ruling of 2026-10-15 (see rules_note): at least unresolved for a citation sweep match of its own text (citation-sweep), a change by a listed tainted commit (tainted-commit) or an include macro the pin cannot read (unread-include); at least the disposition of every file its code includes (include-of-quarantined); and, for a file that only calls tainted or unresolved modules, no disposition but a calls_quarantined list (calls-quarantined). cargo xtask pin-sources and the numeric-provenance check of cargo xtask accept both derive this from the manifest's code_refs and content_facts, so a hand edit of an input's recorded numeric_provenance together with the allowlist fails the check; the check trusts those recorded facts themselves (the code edges, the sweep matches and the touched-by-commit lists), which the infra-m0.5 acceptance case recomputes from git for the sweep and the commits but not for the code edges. A cleared entry does not lift the pin's quarantine of an excel_numeric path; bead dc-ime9 owns that route.
limits: The numeric-provenance check of cargo xtask accept trusts the facts the manifest records per input: the code edges (code_refs), the citation sweep's matches and the touched-by-commit lists (content_facts). It recomputes every provenance and calls_quarantined list from them, never from the recorded numeric_provenance, but it cannot re-derive the facts without the legacy repositories.

The infra-m0.5 acceptance case (infra_m0_5__quarantine_gate) recomputes the citation sweep (git grep) and the touched-by-commit lists (git diff-tree with rename following) from the legacy repositories and spot-checks the cross-repository crate edges (git grep); its derivation of the calls_quarantined lists and of the include rule anchors on the manifest's in-repository code_refs, which only the pin computes.

Cross-repository edges are recorded at crate level, run-time loads are detected only in Rust code (fs::read, fs::read_to_string, fs::read_dir, File::open, OpenOptions, Command::new) and not resolved, and the edges into files that are not pinned inputs are not followed; the manifest and check summaries count them, and dc-4uy4 owns them.

A file is caught as a copy of a tainted function only by its own entry (odd-bond-family), not mechanically; the citation sweep is a fixed list of patterns; a commit outside the tainted list (ffcb9a77, commits_not_listed) is not a taint route.

rules_note: The orchestrator's ruling of 2026-10-15 on infra-m0.5 replaces round 2's transitive callers rule (entry numeric-callers): plan sections 1.1 and 12 quarantine derived material, a property of a file's own content. A file is at least unresolved when its own text matches the citation sweep, when a listed tainted commit changed it, or when its code holds an include macro the pin cannot read; it takes at least the disposition of every file it includes; a file that only calls a tainted or unresolved module keeps its own disposition and carries a calls_quarantined list (in its repository by file, in another repository by crate, and its run-time loads by repository), with which alone the release allowlist admits it. Cross-repository and run-time edges and the edges into files that are not pinned inputs (2 in OxFunc and 197 elsewhere when the ruling was made) are counted in the manifest summary and the check summary and owned by dc-4uy4.
